audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Kennen Levels 2, 4-5, 6 and 2+ items, but Garen wins 54.68% over 1015 games, the packet chart reads Kennen / Skill / Garen x5, and every 'why' string already argues Garen wins those stages ('By level 2 his poke is even', 'Your level 6 R execute deletes his low HP').
audit.why: The side tokens contradict both the data and the prose sitting next to them, so the page tells the player to concede stages he actually wins.
audit.corrected: Realigned the whole chart to the packet as one atomic group — content win[1..5] and full phases[1..6].side/rating — leaving Level 1 to Kennen.

audit.why: Lightning Rush at 10s rank 1 in report[5].t matches the kit (10/9/8/7/6), and the spike order — Level 3 silence, Level 6 execute, first item run-down — is right for a melee bruiser into a squishy mage.
audit.corrected: Only the chart labels around it moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup mentions that Electrical Surge (W) is an on-hit effect, and the itemization line leans on armour and Mortal Reminder.
audit.why: Kennen's damage is magic and scales with attack speed through W's on-hit application, so armour reads the trade wrong — Mercury's Treads and MR are what actually shrink his combo. His stun is the passive Mark of the Storm at three marks, which Decisive Strike's silence can cut short by denying the third application.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[2].text around on-hit magic damage and MR.
